Mór Jókai, ’Midst the Wild Carpathians, translated by Robert Nisbet Bain.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/mor-jokai/midst-the-wild-carpathians/robert-nisbet-bain

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Mór Jókai, author, died 1904.
- Robert Nisbet Bain, translator, writer of the introduction, died 1909.

First publication of the text used: 1894 (SE colophon: '’Midst the Wild Carpathians was published in 1852 by Mór Jókai. It was translated from Hungarian in 1894 by Robert Nisbet Bain.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1894, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: every person named above died in 1925 or earlier (the last to die did so in 1909). So the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.
